category: wisdom

One of the most important lessons i've learned is that pride can masquerade in a manifold of forms. But from what i've lived and seen, the foundations we rest on, cannot be merely planted in the observable or material world. To realize that one is only ever a few steps away from the wrong town, so to speak, is both humbling and haunting.

Pride is like a vulture that watches carefully for it's prety, waiting for a few mis-steps.
